DEVOUR: remove a card from the game.\nIt goes to the devoured pile.
SUPPLANT: assassinate a troop where you have presence,\nthen deploy your own troop in its place.
DEPLOY: put a troop from your barracks on a free space\nwhere you have presence.
ASSASSINATE: remove a troop where you have presence.\nIt goes to your trophy hall (1 VP each).
PLACE A SPY: put a spy on a site.\nIt gives you presence there and counts for control.
RETURN: send a troop or spy where you have presence\nback to its owner.
PROMOTE: move a card into your Inner Circle.\nIt leaves your deck and scores its Inner Circle VP.
BRIBE: give 1 VP token to an opponent of your choice\nto get the effect after the arrow.
STEAL: take VP tokens from another player.
RECRUIT: take a card into your discard pile.
RECRUIT: take a card into your discard pile.
MOVE: take a troop where you have presence\nand put it on any free space.
FOCUS: works if you played another card of this aspect\nthis turn or reveal one from your hand.
SCRY N: look at the top N cards of your deck\nand discard any of them.
MIGHT: works if you devoured a card this turn.\nThe second Might on a card needs 2 devours, and so on.
FROSTBITE: works when this card is discarded from your hand\n(not by the end-of-turn discard).
DEVOTION: works when you recruit or promote this card.
RETAIN: in your turn, keep this card instead of playing it.\nIt comes back into your next hand on top of the usual 5 cards.

GLAMOUR: spend 1 VP token (back to the supply) to switch this ability on.\nOnly one Glamour per card.
EXPLORE: look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put up to one that matches into your hand,\nthe rest on the top or bottom of your deck in any order.
TRANSFORM: this card turns into the stronger card it names.
DISTINCT: count each card aspect only once,\nhowever many cards of it you played this turn.

shuffle. Better cards cost more and are worth more VP.

DROW: the classic toolkit.\nSpies, supplants and promotions, steady and even.
DRAGONS: lots of Influence and Power.\nBig dragons pay VP for sites, total control and trophies.
DEMONS: madness.\nHand opponents Insane Outcasts, devour cards to thin your deck.
ELEMENTALS: Focus.\nA card gets a bonus if you play another card of its aspect.
ABERRATIONS: mind control.\nOpponents discard; play cards from your inner circle or the market.
UNDEAD: sacrifice.\nDevour your own cards for strong one-time effects.
CELESTIAL: order and growth.\nHouse Guards, spies, promotions; dragons Transform.
RAVENLOFT: curses.\nFloods the table with Insane Outcasts and profits from them.
WATERDEEP: Focus combos.\nObedience cards, Double Focus, even an extra turn.
SIEGE: variety.\nPlay cards of different aspects in one turn to unlock bonuses.
MERCENARIES: Bribe.\nGive a rival 1 VP for a stronger effect; lots of VP.
AVERNUS: Execute and Might.\nDevour cards this turn to power up Might effects.
ICEWIND DALE: Frostbite.\nCards fire when discarded from hand; make others discard.
CALIMSHAN: Devotion.\nCards fire when recruited or promoted; recruit and promote a lot.
KARA-TUR: Retain.\nKeep cards in hand for your next turn and build big combos.
FEYWILD: Glamour.\nSpend 1 VP to switch on extra card abilities.
FAR REALM: the swarm.\nDeploy a lot and grow by controlling sites.
CHULT: Explore.\nLook at the top of your deck and pull the cards you need into your hand.
